tn36.core: Click-only programming puzzle. Walls (colour 6) block a move (8 px moves only check the destination), striped beams toggle during runs and break the piece. The left panel and its tabs demonstrate fixed example programs. Every click moves the top timer bar; when it runs out the game is lost.

One 49-click solution (found with a model search, run on the engine): fill the middle column to y=30 and take ball 11 in through the lower-left gate; shorten it to y=8 and swap ball 11 out to the upper-right column while ball 15 comes in; refill to y=30, drop ball 15 into the lower-left column and take ball 14 in from the lower right; then set the upper-right column to y=18, the lower-left to y=42 and the middle to y=10. The stored human sequence (reached via the human prefix) also clears the level.
